headline: TOR @ BAL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is TOR 3.24 at BAL 4.29, with a projected total of 7.53. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward BAL: TOR moved -2.19 runs while BAL moved +0.52, changing the projected margin by -2.72 runs. The projected total fell -1.67, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +15.3%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Spencer Miles has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Ernie Clement, Leody Taveras, Jesús Sánchez, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Myles Straw, Andrés Giménez because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
